evidence: Modifies the libbitcoinkernel C API logging callback (introducing btck_LogEntry) and decouples logging.cpp from the kernel build.
rationale: Replaces string-based log callback delivery with structured btck_LogEntry and removes node-specific logging machinery from the kernel build. This directly improves the C API for external consumers by avoiding brittle string parsing, and dropping node dependencies from the library advances libbitcoinkernel's core goal while enabling #30342 and #33847.
